_comment: Factory defaults for the Magos configurators (radar + APU). Edit and restart the tools to apply. Any missing key — or the whole file — falls back to the built-in values, which match a fresh unit; keys starting with _ are comments and ignored.

ar300._comment: A fresh AR-300 radar boots on `host` with `username`:`password`. The rest are the values APPLIED when provisioning: gateway/dns/netmask of the operational subnet, the NTP server and the timezone.
ar300._comment_channel_ips: Radar channel -> the static IP it gets. Overrides merge per channel, so you can change just one. The channel numbers also select the radar's RF variant (chan0..chan3) — keep the keys 0-3.

apu._comment: A fresh APU boots on `host` with `username`:`password`. `iface` is the APU network interface the static IP is applied to. `timezone` falls back to the ar300 value when omitted.
apu._comment_channel_ips: APU index -> the APU's own static IP (overrides merge per index). APU 0 controls radar channels 0+1, APU 1 controls 2+3; the radars' IPs follow the ar300 channel_ips above.
